participation.context: Read the plot, and left the morning at home.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You saw the title and the hour. You did not bring the morning's death onto the peg.

title: Read Two Gentlemen on the afternoon plot

participation.context: Wrote the share, and did not open the coffer.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote one-and-thirty, pointed at the old ruling, and did not add a new sum.

title: Wrote one-and-thirty beside the old ruling
